entries.german:
Bischof Albert von Passau bestätigt den Tauschvertrag seines Vorgängers, des Bischofs Wernhard, vom 22. Mai 1312 (Urk 85) mit dem Kloster Schlägl.

"Nos, Albertus(1), Dei gracia ecclesie Patauiensis episcopus, ad vniuersorum noticiam volumus deuenire, quod permutacionem bonorum infra scriptorum(2), videlicet omnium agrorum, pratarum et siluarum ad bona in Neydslag et Geyselræut pertinencium, que sunt immediate adiacencia meatui fluminis Muechle distincte et absolute donec ad ryuolum, qui inter Geyselræut et Swobzoede defluit et ab eisdem terminis generaliter per ascensum omnia nemora ac deserciones siue deserta, videlicet in Newndorf, in Hawnstayn, in Mitterræut, in Zagelaw, necnon in Oedenchirchen(3) cum quibuslibet aliis inibi situatis, cultis seu incultis, quesitis seu inquirendis donec ad riuolum, qui Vin[der]sterpach(4) vvlgariter nuncupatur, que venerabilis pater, dominus Wernh[ardus](5), antecessor noster bone memorie propria, ut intelleximus, conparauit pecunia, factam cum bonis in Glaczing et in Liechtenek, in Ruedmarstorf, in Autengrueb, in Pellenczræut, in Mulode et in Swobzoede, de consensu venerabilium fratrum canonicorum ac capituli nostri ratam habemus ac gratam, et ob maiorem firmitatem presentis scripti patrocinio confirmamus. Jn cuius rei testimonium presens scriptum fieri et sigilli nostri munimine fecimus conmuniri, presentibus eciam testibus subnotatis Alb[ero] de Winchel(6) canonico Patauiensi, Ludolfo(7) decano Chremensi, Ortlibo Czændlino(8), magistris Laurentio(9) et Petro(10), notariis nostris, Chalhoho(11) et Chunrado(12) de Valchensteyn et aliis quam pluribus fide dignis. Actum et datum Patauie, anno Domini Mo. CCCo. vicesimo secundo, VIIIo jdus aprilis."

Siegel: Siegel an Pergamentbändchen hängend: Albert, Bischof von Passau; Siegel wie in Urk 109-110 (S 90-91), beschädigt.
entries.english:
Bishop Albert of Passau confirms the property exchange agreement of his predecessor, Bishop Wernhard, dated May 22, 1312 (Charter 85), with Kloster Schlägl.

"We, Albert, by the grace of God Bishop of the Church of Passau, wish to make known to all that we ratify and approve, for the greater firmness, by the patronage of this written document, the exchange of goods set forth below, namely all fields, meadows and forests belonging to the properties in Neydslag and Geyselræut, which adjoin immediately and absolutely adjacent to the course of the Muechle river up to the stream that flows between Geyselræut and Swobzoede, and from those boundaries generally by ascent all woods and wastelands or deserts, namely in Newndorf, in Hawnstayn, in Mitterræut, in Zagelaw, as well as in Oedenchirchen, with whatever else is situated there, cultivated or uncultivated, found or to be found, up to the stream commonly called Vin[der]sterpach, which the venerable father, our lord Wernhard, predecessor of blessed memory, has acquired, as we understand, with his own money, made with the properties in Glaczing and in Liechtenek, in Ruedmarstorf, in Autengrueb, in Pellenczræut, in Mulode and in Swobzoede, with the consent of our venerable brothers the canons and of our chapter, and for greater firmness we confirm it by the patronage of this present writing. In witness of which thing we have had this writing made and sealed with the impression of our seal, the following witnesses being present: Albert of Winchel, canon of Passau; Ludolf, dean of Cremse; Ortlib Czændlino; masters Laurentius and Peter, our notaries; Chalhoho and Conrad of Valchensteyn, and many other faithful people. Given and done at Passau, in the year of the Lord 1322, the eighth day before the Calends of April."

Seal: Seal hanging on a parchment thong: Albert, Bishop of Passau; seal as in Charter 109-110 (S 90-91), damaged.
